name: Biblioteka Nauki (Library of Science) — Poland
notes: Poland's national open-access platform (ICM, University of Warsaw): ~1,790 journals, 645,000+ articles, ~2,960 books, free full text. Live search WIRED in build_article.py (search_european_platforms, tag europe:bibliotekanauki) via the platform's public JSON API POST /api/search {searchCriteria:{generalSearchString, openResources:true}, paginationCriteria}, probed 2026-11-26: HTTP 200 JSON with real documents (totalResults 2,760 for 'earthquake'); only documents carrying a PDF in fullTextFormats and not accessRestricted are emitted, and a returned item's full text was verified reachable (GET /articles/64160793.pdf -> HTTP 200, application/pdf, %PDF-1.4, ~400 KB). The web UI itself is a JavaScript SPA shell.

name: Persée — French scholarly journals digital library
notes: French national digital library of scholarly journals (ENS Lyon / CNRS): 400+ collections, 1M+ documents, full text. Live search WIRED in build_article.py (search_european_platforms, tag europe:persee) via GET /search?ta=article&q=<q>, probed 2026-11-26: HTTP 200 with real doc-result items (31,426 results for 'tremblement'). Full text verified reachable as page-based OCR HTML: a returned item's document page links its text pages at /doc/page/<docid>/<pageid>, and the first page of 'Le tremblement de terre d'Arette' (1968) opened with the article's full text readable. The one-file PDF endpoint (/docAsPDF/) is protected by an altcha anti-bot challenge (HTTP 403) and is not used. Backfiles carry a moving wall for recent years.

name: E-Periodica — Swiss journals online (ETH Library)
notes: ETH Library platform for digitised Swiss journals: 400+ journals from the 18th century to today, 7.7M+ pages, full-text search. Live search WIRED in build_article.py (search_european_platforms, tag europe:eperiodica) via GET /search?q=<q>, probed 2026-11-26: HTTP 200 with real ep-result article items for 'Erdbeben'. Full text verified reachable: a returned item's issue OCR full text (GET /download/sbz-002:1931:97/ocr-fulltext -> HTTP 200, text/plain, ~2 MB of real OCR text) and its per-page texts in the /view/ reader are openly readable. Some recent items carry a moving-wall embargo (data-movingwall, e.g. 24 months); those candidates simply fail the unchanged downstream gates.

name: tidsskrift.dk — Danish open-access journals (Royal Danish Library)
notes: Danish national host for open-access journals (OJS). Live search WIRED in build_article.py (search_european_platforms, tag europe:tidsskrift) via the OJS site-wide search GET /index.php/index/search/search?query=<q>, probed 2026-11-26: HTTP 200 with 25 real obj_article_summary results for 'earthquake'; a returned article's galley PDF was verified reachable (GET /geografisktidsskrift/article/download/44887/54238 -> HTTP 200, application/pdf, %PDF-1.4).

name: Hrčak — Portal of Croatian scientific and professional journals
notes: Croatia's national journal portal (SRCE, University of Zagreb): 550+ journals, 310,000+ full-text articles, OAI-PMH provider. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, every search path (/pretraga, /search, /en/search) answered HTTP 418 with a 'Confirm you're not a robot' human-verification page from the build sandbox, so no machine-usable keyword route could be verified; article pages themselves answer (HTTP 200) and the OAI-PMH Identify answers but OAI is harvest-only, not keyword search. Its articles remain reachable via Crossref/DOAJ/OpenAIRE.

name: Journal.fi — Finnish scholarly journals online
notes: Finland's national journal platform (Federation of Finnish Learned Societies): ~150 scholarly journals, OJS-based, mostly diamond OA with full text. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the OJS site-wide search answered an anti-bot proof-of-work challenge page ('Making sure you're not a bot!') instead of results; the OAI-PMH Identify answers (HTTP 200 XML) but OAI is harvest-only, not keyword search. Its journals remain reachable via DOAJ/OpenAlex.

name: OpenJournals.nl — Dutch national diamond open-access platform
notes: Netherlands national diamond-OA journal platform (KNAW / NWO): ~47-54 journals, OJS-based at the journal level. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, openjournals.nl itself is a WordPress portal with no platform-wide article search (OJS search paths answered HTTP 404) and each journal lives on its own host, so no single machine-usable keyword route exists at the platform level. Its journals remain reachable via DOAJ.

name: OpenEdition Journals — France
notes: French/European humanities and social sciences platform (CNRS / Cléo): 654 journals and 15,000+ books, majority open access (rest freemium). Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, journals.openedition.org answered an anti-bot proof-of-work challenge page instead of search results from the build sandbox, so no machine-usable route could be verified. HAL (already a live searcher) covers much French scholarship.

name: SCIndeks — Serbian Citation Index (CEON)
notes: Serbia's national citation index and OA full-text journal repository (CEON, Belgrade): 230+ Serbian journals, OAI-PMH provider. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the ASP.NET search results page answered HTTP 200 but reported 'no records' for every plain-GET parameterisation tried (query=, q=, tp=0&q=, English and Serbian terms) — the working search is a stateful form flow; OAI-PMH is harvest-only. Its content remains reachable via OpenAIRE/Crossref.

name: RCAAP — Portuguese open-access scientific repositories portal
notes: Portugal's national aggregator of open-access repositories (articles, conference papers, theses). Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the results page answered an anti-bot proof-of-work challenge page ('Making sure you're not a bot!') instead of results, so no machine-usable route could be verified. Portuguese repository content remains reachable via OpenAIRE.

name: Dialnet — Hispanic scientific literature portal (University of La Rioja)
notes: Spain's portal for Hispanic scientific production: 10,000+ journals, 5M+ documents, ~110k theses; full text linked for part of the records. Registry-only under the full-text-only law: probed 2026-11-26, the document search answered HTTP 200 with real results (some items marked 'Texto completo'), but every follow-up connection from the build sandbox — the article page, the /descarga/articulo/<id>.pdf download and the external full-text link — was dropped by the server, so no returned item's full text could be verified reachable. Spanish scholarship remains reachable via DOAJ/OpenAlex and the SciELO/Redalyc routes in the registries.

name: EKT ePublishing — Greek National Documentation Centre
notes: Greece's national OA publishing platform (National Documentation Centre): journals, books and conference proceedings, per-journal OJS sites. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the platform search paths answered HTTP 500 (/en/search, /search, /en/search/search) and the OJS index search path answered 404; no site-wide machine-usable keyword route could be verified. Greek journals remain reachable via DOAJ/OpenAIRE.

name: SSOAR — Social Science Open Access Repository (GESIS, Germany)
notes: German social-science open-access repository (GESIS): journal articles and working papers with full text. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the site is a DSpace single-page app — the discover page, the DSpace 7 REST search path and the OAI path all answered the same HTML app shell (HTTP 200, no results), so no machine-usable keyword route could be verified. Its content remains reachable via BASE/OpenAIRE/OpenAlex.

name: BASE — Bielefeld Academic Search Engine (Germany)
notes: One of the world's largest academic search engines for open-access resources (Bielefeld University Library), aggregating repositories worldwide. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the search results page answered an anti-bot proof-of-work challenge page ('Making sure you're not a bot!') instead of results, so no machine-usable route could be verified. The engine already queries the same underlying sources directly (OpenAIRE, DOAJ, Internet Archive).

name: DiVA portal — Nordic universities' publications and theses
notes: Publication portal of ~50 Nordic universities and research institutes (articles, theses, reports). Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the JSF simple-search GET answered the search form page itself (HTTP 200, no result records — the working search is a stateful POST/session flow, and the portal itself was announcing search disruptions). Nordic university content remains reachable via OpenAIRE/OpenAlex.

name: Idunn — Universitetsforlaget journals platform (Norway)
notes: Norwegian university-press journals platform (Universitetsforlaget), partly open access. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the search path answered HTTP 403 from the build sandbox, so no machine-usable route could be verified; the platform is also only partly OA. Norwegian journals remain reachable via DOAJ.

name: ETERA — National Library of Estonia digital library
notes: Digital library of the National Library of Estonia (digitised books, journals, newspapers). Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the search path answered a small JavaScript app shell (HTTP 200, no results), so no machine-usable keyword route could be verified; Estonia has no dedicated national OA journals portal. Estonian journals remain reachable via DOAJ.

name: OUCI — Open Ukrainian Citation Index
notes: Ukrainian citation index and search engine built on Crossref metadata with an open-access filter (SSTL of Ukraine). Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the site and its search answered HTTP 403 from the build sandbox, so no machine-usable route could be verified; it is an index route rather than a host, and the engine already queries Crossref/Unpaywall directly.

name: Scientific Periodicals of Ukraine — Vernadsky National Library
notes: The Vernadsky National Library of Ukraine's scientific periodicals collection: ~0.5M articles from ~1,700 Ukrainian journals. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the library homepage answers (HTTP 200) but the periodicals catalogue (UJRN) is a legacy frameset interface and no machine-usable keyword endpoint could be verified. Ukrainian journals remain reachable via DOAJ/OpenAlex.

name: REAL — Repository of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences
notes: Institutional repository of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences (MTA): articles, books, theses. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the EPrints simple-search GET ends in a 302 redirect loop (stateful search screens) and its OAI-PMH is harvest-only, so no machine-usable keyword route could be verified. Hungarian content remains reachable via OpenAIRE/DOAJ.

name: SciELO Portugal
notes: Portuguese node of the SciELO open-access journal library, full text. Registry-only for the Portugal node: probed 2026-11-26, the scielo.pt search script answered an error page and the global SciELO search (search.scielo.org) answered HTTP 403 from the build sandbox, so no machine-usable route could be verified for this node. SciELO content remains reachable via DOAJ/OpenAlex.

name: RACO — Catalan open-access journals (CSUC)
notes: Catalan open-access journals platform (Consorci de Serveis Universitaris de Catalunya): ~500 journals with full text, OJS-based. Registry-only: probed 2026-11-26, the OJS search path answered HTTP 403 from the build sandbox, so no machine-usable route could be verified. Catalan journals remain reachable via DOAJ.

name: Czech Digital Mathematics Library (DML-CZ)
notes: Czech digital library for mathematics literature (Masaryk University and partners): digitised Czech mathematics journals with full text. Registry-only: Czechia has no general national OA journals portal; this subject library's search page answers (HTTP 200 XHTML, probed 2026-11-26) but it was not wired — mathematics full texts are already covered by the zbMATH searcher and DOAJ. Recorded so the Czech gap is documented with its one real subject route, not a fabricated general portal.
